$comment: Which allyabase base a build talks to. build.rs reads this, picks ONE entry, and bakes its values in as env!() consts, so the binary carries exactly one host.

Everything is derived from `host` because the 8as.world droplets use path-based routing: nginx terminates TLS on 443 and proxies /<service>/ to that service's local port (bdo 3003, addie 3005). One hostname, one certificate, every service under it.
Odd build numbers are built against dev, even against prod. scripts/build-ios.cjs enforces that pairing; see BUILD_PARITY there.
getpayed was hardcoded to dev until 2026-09-28, so prod is the newly reachable half here, not dev.
